safetyPage.advanceBody: This is the single most common scam. Anyone who asks for a deposit, booking fee, registration charge or “refundable” payment before you have seen the item is almost certainly trying to steal from you. Genuine sellers are paid when you meet. The same applies to jobs: a real employer never charges you to apply.
safetyPage.inspectBody: Switch the phone on. Start the bike. Check the serial number. Ask for the bill or warranty card. A seller who resists a reasonable inspection is telling you something.
safetyPage.linksBody: Never open a shortened link a stranger sends you. And never enter your UPI PIN to receive money—a PIN is only ever needed to send it. Anyone telling you otherwise is stealing from you.
safetyPage.linksTitle: Be careful with links and UPI
safetyPage.metadataDescription: Find it here.. Deal it near.. LocZ is a location-first local discovery platform for India—classifieds, jobs, offers and services near you.
safetyPage.privateBody: You do not have to share your phone number. LocZ messages let you talk to a buyer or seller without either of you giving anything away, and your number stays hidden unless you choose to display it on your ad.
safetyPage.publicBody: Meet during the day, somewhere busy—a metro station, a mall, a market. Take someone with you if you can. Do not invite a stranger to your home, and do not go alone to an address you have never heard of.
safetyPage.reportBody: Every ad has a Report this ad link. Reports go to a real person, and several reports about the same ad pull it out of public view while we look. You will be told the outcome in your notifications.
safetyPage.subtitle: Buy and sell near you. Join in a minute.
safetyPage.title: Post your ad

aboutPage.cleanBody: Open posting attracts spam, so every new account’s first ads are reviewed by a person before they go live, and anything our checks flag goes to the same queue. Read more about
aboutPage.freeBody: Creating an ad, job vacancy, offer or business profile costs nothing, and it will stay that way. We may add paid promotion later for businesses that want more visibility, but the ability to post and to be found is not something we intend to charge for.
aboutPage.intro: LocZ is a location-first place to buy, sell and find things near you—used goods, local jobs, offers from nearby shops, services, rooms to rent and businesses in your area. It is built for India, starting with Telangana and Andhra Pradesh.
aboutPage.languageBody: LocZ is available in English, Telugu and Hindi. You can change language at any time from the menu in the header.
aboutPage.localBody: Everything on LocZ is anchored to a place. You can browse a whole city, narrow to a locality, or search within one, three, five, ten, twenty-five or fifty kilometres of where you are. Sharing your precise location is optional—city-level browsing works just as well.
aboutPage.metadataDescription: Find it here.. Deal it near.. LocZ is a location-first local discovery platform for India—classifieds, jobs, offers and services near you.

helpPage.a1: No. Posting ads, jobs, offers and business profiles costs nothing today, and there is no charge to be found in search.
helpPage.a2: The first ads from every new account are checked by a person before they go live—usually within a few hours. It is how we keep spam off the site. After that, most ads publish immediately.
helpPage.a3: You will see the reason on the ad under My ads. The usual causes are contact details written into the description instead of the contact fields, a shortened link, or a duplicate of an ad you already have live. Fix it and submit again.
helpPage.a4: Marketplace ads and jobs run for 30 days, buyer requirements for 15 and rentals for 45. Offers and events run until the end date you set. We remind you before an ad expires, and republishing takes one tap.
helpPage.a5: Yes, and it is hidden by default. Choose “Messages on LocZ only” when posting and buyers can still reach you without seeing your number.
helpPage.a6: Open My ads and tap Mark as sold. The ad stops appearing in search straight away.
helpPage.a7: Use Report this ad, or block them from the conversation. Blocking stops contact in both directions immediately.
helpPage.a8: Go to Account, then delete account. Your ads are removed straight away. We keep a minimal record for a short period so we can handle any dispute, then anonymise it.

privacyPage.notDoBody: We do not sell your personal data. We do not show your phone number to anyone unless you chose to publish it. And we strip the location data out of the photos you upload before anyone else can see them—a photo taken at home should not tell a stranger where you live.
privacyPage.retentionBody: Listings are removed when you delete them or when they expire. Messages are kept while the conversation exists. Security and moderation records are kept for a limited period so we can investigate abuse and settle disputes.
privacyPage.title: Post your ad
privacyPage.visibilityBody: Your listings, display name and the city you post in are public. Your phone number, email address and messages are not, unless you publish the number yourself.

termsPage.allowedBody: Only things you are legally entitled to sell, offer or advertise, described honestly, at a real price, in the right category and in the right place. You are responsible for your listings and for the transactions you enter into.
termsPage.contentBody: You keep ownership of what you post. You give us permission to display, resize and distribute it for the purpose of running and promoting LocZ.
termsPage.draftNotice: This is a plain-language draft written for launch. Have it reviewed by a lawyer familiar with the Information Technology Act and the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules before operating commercially.
termsPage.eligibilityBody: You must be 18 or older and provide a working Indian mobile number. One person, one account.
termsPage.endingBody: You may delete your account at any time. We may close an account that repeatedly breaches these terms.
termsPage.metadataDescription: Find it here.. Deal it near.. LocZ is a location-first local discovery platform for India—classifieds, jobs, offers and services near you.
termsPage.moderationBody: We may review, refuse, pause or remove any listing, and suspend an account, where our rules or the law require it. Where we remove something we tell you why, and you can ask us to look again.
termsPage.platformBody: We connect buyers and sellers. We do not own, inspect, guarantee or deliver anything listed here, we hold no payments, and we are not a party to any agreement you make. As an intermediary we act on notice: report something and we will review it.
termsPage.platformTitle: LocZ is a platform, not a party to your deal
termsPage.prohibitedBody: Weapons, drugs, wildlife, counterfeit goods, stolen property, identity documents, prescription medicines, adult services, financial products you are not licensed to offer, or anything prohibited by Indian law. No spam, no misleading prices, no advance-fee schemes, and no impersonating another person or business.
